name: searchski
description: Ski-vacation decision engine for the Israeli market

scripts.etl:all: npm run etl:fetch && npm run etl:build
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @searchski/core -w @searchski/affiliates -w @searchski/nlp -w @searchski/etl && npm run -w @searchski/web typecheck
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run golden && npm run build

overridesReason: Raises the top-level postcss to a patched release. It does NOT clear `npm audit`: Next 15 keeps a nested postcss@8.4.31 and holds sharp below 0.35, and neither budges via overrides. `npm audit fix` proposes downgrading Next to 9.3.3 (2020), which is not a fix. See README > Known issues for the risk assessment and the real remedy (Next 16).
